{
 "cwd": "/workspace",
 "query": "Prompt: Create a premium, Apple-inspired responsive pricing page website for a modern music production platform called SonicBloom Studio. This must be a pure static front-end website only, built with React and Tailwind CSS, no backend, no database, no login, no real payments, no API calls. Use mock/static content for all plans, testimonials, FAQ, and form submissions. The page should feel like an elegant Apple product page mixed with a creative music brand: clean spacing, glossy gradient backgrounds, soft glass cards, big typography, smooth sections, subtle shadows, and a luxury audio-tech feeling. Main Goal: Build a beautiful pricing page that helps musicians, producers, podcasters, and small studios compare subscription plans and request a custom quote. Visual Style: Premium gradient theme with deep midnight navy, electric violet, soft cyan, warm pink, and clean white text. Use large rounded cards, frosted glass panels, subtle noise texture if possible with CSS, glowing accents, and minimal Apple-like layout. No dark clutter, keep it clean and expensive. Website Sections: 1. Top Navigation: Left logo text SonicBloom Studio with small waveform icon using CSS or simple SVG. Center nav links: Pricing, Features, Compare, FAQ, Contact. Right buttons: Listen Demo and Start Free Preview. Sticky transparent nav that becomes readable on gradient background. 2. Hero Pricing Section: Big headline: Choose the sound plan that grows with your music. Subtitle explaining static mock pricing for creators, bands, teachers, and studios. Add two pill badges like New 2026 Plans and No credit card required. Include toggle UI for Monthly / Yearly pricing but it can be static visual only or basic front-end state, no billing. Add Apple-style product glow behind the pricing cards. 3. Pricing Cards: Four detailed pricing cards with gradient borders and different emphasis. Starter Beat: $9/mo for beginners, includes 10 project templates, basic loops, export presets, email support text only. Creator Mix: $19/mo, recommended badge, includes 100 sample packs, vocal chain presets, royalty-free loops, collaboration guide, priority support mock. Studio Pro: $39/mo, for serious producers, includes unlimited mock projects, mastering presets, stems organizer, advanced sound library, release checklist. Label Suite: Custom, for teams and music schools, includes seat packs, brand kits, curriculum content, onboarding call placeholder. Each card needs CTA button. Buttons do not connect anywhere, can scroll to form. Include beautiful icons using lucide-react or inline SVG, no image downloading required. 4. Feature Comparison Table: Complex responsive comparison section showing rows like Track Templates, Sample Library, Mastering Presets, Vocal Tools, Collaboration Notes, Licensing Guide, Support Level, Export Formats, Learning Resources. Use check marks, partial labels, and plan names. On mobile convert to stacked cards if easier. 5. Value Highlight Strip: Three large gradient cards: Made for Bedroom Producers, Built for Podcast Studios, Ready for Music Schools. Each card should have short copy and a mini metric like 500+ mock loops, 40 preset chains, 12 lesson packs. 6. Interactive Form Section: Add a static quote/contact form called Build My Music Plan. Fields: Full Name, Email Address, Creator Type dropdown, Preferred Plan dropdown, Monthly Budget range slider, Music Genre checkboxes, Message textarea, checkbox for Send me sample pricing guide. On submit, prevent default and show a polished success message like Thanks! This static demo captured your request locally. Do not send data anywhere. The form should look premium with glassmorphism and gradient focus rings. 7. FAQ Accordion: Create front-end accordion interaction only. Questions: Can I use these sounds commercially? Is this a real checkout page? Can I switch plans later? Do you offer education pricing? Are the samples and prices real? Answer clearly that it is a static demo / sample content where appropriate. 8. Testimonials: Add 3 mock testimonials from fictional musicians/producers with names like Maya R., Theo Banks, Luna Mix Lab. Use star ratings and small gradient avatar circles, no real people photos needed. 9. Final CTA: Large cinematic gradient section with headline: Your next track deserves a better workflow. Buttons: Compare Plans and Request Custom Quote. 10. Footer: Minimal footer with logo, small links, copyright, and note: Static pricing page demo, no payments processed. Interactions Required: pricing toggle monthly/yearly updates visible prices using front-end state only; FAQ accordion; form success state; smooth scroll nav links; hover effects on pricing cards; selected recommended plan visual highlight. Technical Requirements: Use React with Tailwind CSS. Make it fully responsive for desktop, tablet, and mobile. No external APIs, no authentication, no database, no server-side code, no Stripe or payment integration. Everything must render as a static site with sample content. Use semantic HTML, accessible labels, good contrast, keyboard-friendly buttons, and clean reusable components. Make the design feel polished enough for a real SaaS music brand pricing page inspired by Apple.com spacing and premium product presentation, but do not copy Apple branding or assets.",
 "judge": {
  "model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8",
  "model_sha": "94125d2bd83076b21eed33119525e29eaf3894f4",
  "request_model": "meta-llama/Llama-4-Maverick-17B-128E-Instruct-FP8:novita",
  "provider": "novita",
  "pinned_on": "2026-10-09",
  "temperature": 0,
  "max_tokens": 1024,
  "rubric_id": "rva1:mean(visual,query,asset)"
 }
}

"""Grade a Webdev task as the explorer does (verl recipes/design webdev-eval): render, shrink, judge.

No index.html in dist/ scores 0. A render that fails, or a judge that never answers, writes no reward (not scored):
neither says anything about the page."""
import base64
import io
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, "/tests")
os.environ["WEBDEV_GRADE_HTTP"] = "1"   # serve over loopback http so React/Vue/ES-module sites actually run
from webdev.eval_rubric import build_prompt  # noqa: E402
from webdev.shot import _build_shot_cmd, _parse_render_env, _parse_shot_b64  # noqa: E402
from webdev.verdict import parse_verdict  # noqa: E402

cfg = json.loads(Path("/tests/grade.json").read_text())
V = Path("/logs/verifier")
V.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
dist = Path(cfg["cwd"]) / "dist"


def done(reward: float | None, why: str, **extra) -> None:
    (V / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "summary": why, **extra}, indent=1))
    print(why)
    if reward is None:
        print("not scored", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    (V / "reward.txt").write_text(f"{reward}\n")
    sys.exit(0)


files = sorted(str(p.relative_to(dist)) for p in dist.rglob("*") if p.is_file())[:200] if dist.is_dir() else []
if "index.html" not in files:
    done(0.0, "The agent delivered nothing to dist/." if not files else "dist/ has no index.html, so there is no page to open.",
         delivered=files)
res = subprocess.run(["sh", "-c", _build_shot_cmd(f"file://{dist}/index.html")], capture_output=True, text=True,
                     timeout=150)   # SHOT_TIMEOUT_S
shot = {"output": (res.stdout or "") + "\n" + (res.stderr or "")}
shot_b64, console_errors = _parse_shot_b64(shot)
render_env = _parse_render_env(shot)
if render_env.get("proxy_failed") or not shot_b64:
    print(shot["output"][-2000:], file=sys.stderr)
    done(None, "external assets were unreachable on every route" if render_env.get("proxy_failed")
         else "the screenshot produced no image")
jpg = base64.b64decode(shot_b64)
try:   # eval_mode._shrink: the judge refuses shots over 20 MP; proportional, quality 75
    from PIL import Image
    Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS = None
    im = Image.open(io.BytesIO(jpg))
    size = im.size
    if im.width * im.height > 20e6:
        k = (20e6 / (im.width * im.height)) ** 0.5
        im = im.convert("RGB").resize((max(1, int(im.width * k)), max(1, int(im.height * k))), Image.LANCZOS)
        b = io.BytesIO(); im.save(b, "JPEG", quality=75); jpg = b.getvalue(); size = im.size
except ImportError:
    size = None
(V / "screenshot.jpg").write_bytes(jpg)
content = [{"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": "data:image/jpeg;base64," + base64.b64encode(jpg).decode()}},
           {"type": "text", "text": build_prompt().format(query=cfg["query"][:1500])}]   # QUERY_CAP
url = os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_URL", "https://router.huggingface.co/v1").rstrip("/") + "/chat/completions"
_judge_pin = cfg["judge"]
if os.environ.get("WEBDEV_JUDGE_REVISION") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
    done(None, "Judge deployment revision is unbound; not scored.")
(V / "judge_config.json").write_text(json.dumps(_judge_pin, indent=1))
body = json.dumps({"model": cfg["judge"]["request_model"], "temperature": 0, "max_tokens": 1024,  # webdev-temp0-pin@1
                   "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": content}]}).encode()
verdict, last = None, ""
for attempt in range(4):   # JUDGE_RETRIES, with eval_mode's backoff
    if attempt:
        time.sleep(min(60.0, 3.0 * (3 ** (attempt - 1))) * (0.5 + random.random()))
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, method="POST", headers={
            "Content-Type": "application/json", "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('WEBDEV_JUDGE_KEY', '')}"})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=180) as r:   # JUDGE_TIMEOUT_S
            _judge_reply = json.loads(r.read())
            if _judge_reply.get("model_revision") != _judge_pin["model_sha"]:
                done(None, "Judge response revision differs from the task pin; not scored.")
            msg = _judge_reply["choices"][0]["message"]
        v = parse_verdict(msg.get("content") or msg.get("reasoning_content") or "")
        if "_failed" not in v:
            verdict = v
            break
        last = v["_failed"]
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:200]
if not verdict:
    done(None, f"judge unavailable: {last}")
done(verdict["score"], verdict.get("reason", ""), dims=verdict["dims"], visual=verdict["visual"], screenshot_size=size,
     console_errors=console_errors[:1500] if console_errors not in ("", "[]") else "")

rationale: Use temperature zero and bind the model/provider request and artifact revision; mask absent or mismatched deployment/response revision. Version-aware judge endpoint validation is staged.
